question: Geico, Honda, OR Discover renews multi-year NHL TNT sponsorship before 2026 upfront close
resolution_criterion: At least one of {Geico, Honda, Discover} announces or is reported to have renewed a multi-year NHL/TNT Sports sponsorship deal between 2026-04-28 and the 2026 upfront close (typically July 31, 2026), per Variety/AdAge/Sportico/MediaPost
